english.title: Driver of motor vehicle fail to attempt to reclaim / notify about shed load - Blackwell / Silvertown Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE..) which had shed its load in the

(A)_[Blackwall]_
(B)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel, such that it caused or may have caused an obstruction or hazard to users of the tunnel, failed to(C)_[attempt to reclaim the load]_
(D)_[immediately inform authorised persons of the loss of load, immediate location and details of and contact details for, the owner of the load]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(13) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
